name: Vivek Kumar
title: Graphic & UI/UX Designer
profile: Graphic & UI/UX Designer with about a year of hands-on experience across brand identity, packaging, social campaigns and product interfaces. At AlgoRoot I rebuilt brand identities, redesigned the company website and revamped AI product UIs, taking work from wireframes to developer-ready Figma files. My recent case studies pair user research and accessible design systems with motion, from a medicine-care app for older parents to a bilingual Diwali packaging campaign.

bullets: Rebuilt brand identity: redesigned the AlgoRoot logo and created a new visual identity for AlgoJob.
Redesigned the AlgoRoot website end to end, bringing clearer visual hierarchy, typography and consistency across pages.
Revamped the UI/UX of AlgoJob's AI career platform with simpler navigation and information architecture, and redesigned the AlgoVox product interface.
Produced wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity Figma files with developer handoff documentation.
Worked with dev and marketing teams in an agile setup and applied WCAG accessibility standards.

projects.name: FIKR
bullets: Concept app where a parent confirms medicines with one "Taken" tap, so a child far away is reassured without the parent feeling watched. Five interviews, affinity mapping, personas, user flows, wireframes, a Material 3 system with night mode, bilingual UI and an After Effects film.

projects.name: VOLT 47
bullets: 24-hour gym identity built on one mark read three ways (a 23° wedge, three barbell plates, a negative-space bolt): logo suite, colour and type system, pattern, eight applications, social kit and an eight-second logo reveal with sound.

projects.name: Shady?
projects.tag: AI Scam Checker · UI/UX Case Study
bullets: AI scam checker for families: a calm verdict, the red flags underlined and one next step. Competitor review, three personas, a token-based light and dark design system, accessible screens, a prototype and a launch film.

projects.name: CHASHNI
bullets: Bilingual (Devanagari + Latin) Diwali mithai brand whose box colour names the sweet inside: print-ready packaging with dielines, plus one campaign line across three reels and three carousels.

projects.name: ShopUp
bullets: Research and usability testing with 6 participants; redesigned discovery and checkout and added real-time delivery tracking.

projects.name: BIJLI BAZAAR
bullets: Designed nine posts for a fictional night mela, each in 4:5 and 9:16, every one solving a different layout problem inside one system of five colours, two typefaces and four type treatments.
